reactor_type: 6 × 6 in. rectangular shaped ALD reactor (ISAC Research Inc.)
evidence: The PEALD cycle consisted of four steps of Si precursor dose, purging with N 2 gas, applying N 2 plasma, and purging with N 2 gas ( Fig. 1 (b)). The process working pressure was set to 770 mTorr with a N 2 gas flow rate maintained at 500 sccm, and the growth temperature was changed from 60 to 250 °C.
